# Portico
> Go framework for interactive, multi-user terminal sites over SSH. This index is the site-author manual only (docs/manual/); building-a-site.md and site-agents.md remain in the Portico GitHub repo at your module tag.

## Bootstrap
curl -fsSL https://bmd-studios.com/portico/llms.txt
curl -fsSL https://bmd-studios.com/portico/docs/manual/README.md

Pin manual fetches to the same git tag as `github.com/MrBlindMouse/Portico` in your site's `go.mod`.
